title: Amelia | Striped Shirt with Tangerine Colour Block
bodyHtml:
This shirt is all about graphic contrast done right. Delicate stripes give way to a bold tangerine block that catches the eye without screaming for attention—a modern, vibrant look that feels naturally put together. The relaxed fit and soft drape mean you can throw it on and feel effortless, whether it's weekend brunch in Melbourne or a casual city day. It's the kind of piece that adds instant colour and personality to your wardrobe without any fuss.

Why you'll love it

  • Colour block design in tangerine and white—a striking graphic moment that's hard to find done this well
  • Striped base that transitions into solid colour for a perfectly balanced, contemporary feel
  • Relaxed fit with natural drape—moves with you all day without clinging
  • Light and breathable, keeping you comfortable on warm days and in cooler evenings alike
  • Pairs effortlessly with white trousers, light jeans or minimal skirts—instantly complete
  • Works everywhere: weekend brunches, city wandering, casual drinks, everyday wear
  • That rare find—stripes and colour block working in perfect harmony
